messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: SEV2: multiple runtime workers OOM'ing in prod-west-2 (runtime service). Auto-thread created.

Nina P: ack, I'm looking. initial alert shows a cluster-wide spike starting ~01:10 UTC. paging on-call.

oncall-bot: Paging @Leah T (oncall) for SEV2.

Leah T: I'm on call. grabbing node snapshots + recent deploys. any customer reports?

Carlos M: saw a burst of 503s from the nlp-embed pipeline, correlates with retries. Early metric: OOM count 42 in 6m across 4 nodes.

Devon H: FYI we flipped `batch_concurrency_limit` from 16 -> 24 in prod-west-2 at 00:45 during a scaling experiment. Could be relevant.

Nina P: ok that's new. sending current worker logs:

```
[2026-03-15T01:12:02Z] runtime-worker-12: failed alloc cudaMalloc(536870912) -> cudaErrorMemoryAllocation
[2026-03-15T01:12:02Z] runtime-worker-12: gpu_total=65536MB gpu_free=128MB gpu_used=65344MB
[2026-03-15T01:12:02Z] runtime-worker-12: kv_cache_reserved=31.8GB kv_cache_active=29.1GB
[2026-03-15T01:12:03Z] runtime-worker-12: concurrent_requests=19 inflight_tokens=17280
[2026-03-15T01:12:03Z] kubelet: OOMKilled container runtime-worker-12
```

Leah T: interesting that total is 64GB here. which allocator backend is in use? (jemalloc vs our custom GPU slab).

Devon H: we run allocator=v2-slab on this pool. v2-slab had a small patch on 2026-03-10 to reduce coalescing to avoid stalls.

Carlos M: hypothesizing two causes: kv cache heavy reservation + increased concurrency causing many small allocations that fragment the slab. Also possible regression in allocator v2-slab.

Nina P: mitigation attempt A: reduce `batch_concurrency_limit` back 24 -> 12 to reduce simultaneous allocs. Rolling to runtime pool now (5 pods at a time).

Leah T: mitigation B: issue `rdwctl config set kv_cache.enabled_prefix_caching false --scope=prod-west-2` to stop growing prefix allocations. Doing that now.

infra-bot: rdwctl: applied kv cache setting.

Devon H: also triggering a graceful drain on the two hottest nodes to force container restart and free fragmented GPU memory: `kubectl drain node-54 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`. Doing in staging first then prod.

Nina P: watching metrics: within 90s after throttling concurrency and disabling prefix caching, OOMs dropped to 4 in 10m from 42 in 6m. p95 latency improved ~220ms.

Leah T: quick note on customer impact: initial surge caused ~0.12% of daily requests to see 5xx; top affected customer had ~1200 failed requests in 7m. Ops ticket created: INC-2026-3189.

Carlos M: logging evidence for fragmentation: `nvidia-smi` sample from node-54 shows many scattered allocations:

```
GPU Memory Allocations:
- 64MB x 120
- 8MB x 430
- 256MB x 10
Free contiguous chunk largest=256MB
Total free=192MB
```

Leah T: that aligns with slab fragmentation — contiguous alloc for KV scratch/activations fails.

Devon H: temp patch proposal: enable small-allocation-optimizer (falls back to pooled 4MB bins) via `rdwctl runtime set allocator_flags=small_bin_opt=true` on the pool. This should reduce fragmentation pressure.

Nina P: apply patch to 2 pods as canary.

infra-bot: allocator_flags applied to runtime-worker-canary-1, runtime-worker-canary-2.

Carlos M: canary results: no OOMs on canaries for 12m under test load; memory patterns show larger contiguous free chunks after GC-ish coalescing.

Leah T: good. rolling patch across remaining pods with batch concurrency=12 and prefix_caching disabled.

Nina P: rolling complete. monitoring window now.

Devon H: long-term hypotheses for RCA:
- H1: Increase in batch_concurrency_limit exposed allocator v2-slab coalescing regression -> fragmentation under many small allocations.
- H2: Aggressive KV prefix caching increased reserved resident set size, lowering headroom for contiguous allocations.
- H3: Interaction between our allocator and driver-level behavior (possibly driver 526.x) causing slower free/coalesce.

Carlos M: evidence list to collect for RCA:
- per-node `nvidia-smi` timelines every 5s for 30m (before + after mitigations)
- allocator internal stats snapshot (bin usage, free-list sizes) from tracing
- control-plane config history showing batch_concurrency change at 00:45 and kv_cache toggles at 00:30
- client request size distribution around 01:00-01:15

Nina P: action items during incident: 
- Leah: keep oncall for next 60m, confirm no regression.
- Devon: run allocator unit tests + reproduce locally with kv_cache simulated reservations.
- Carlos: assemble `nvidia-smi` + allocation maps and upload to artifacts.
- Nina: contact top affected customer with status + mitigation steps and ETA.

Leah T: ticket updated with actions. setting incident to mitigated state but keeping thread open for RCA evidence.

infra-bot: Incident summary auto-note: mitigations applied (concurrency cap rollback, prefix caching disabled, small-bin allocator enabled). Estimated affected requests: ~0.12% of daily traffic. Root cause TBD.

Nina P: planning follow-up: repro job (kv_cache=32GB + concurrency 20, synthetic 512-1024 token streams) and driver/allocator matrix testing. I'll own scheduling and postmortem. Meeting proposed 2026-03-16 09:30 UTC.

Carlos M: adding extra: check quantized path and memory footprint differences; maybe quantized kernels allocate differently and avoid fragmentation.

Leah T: thanks team. if anyone finds a smoking-gun log paste it here. I'll keep watch for 1h. :eyes:
